# Cultural Brain

> Cultural Brain is a B2B cultural intelligence software platform by Hispaño for agencies and brands, connecting cultural research, evidence, media planning and learning, with a focus on U.S. Hispanic audiences.

## Product
- [Platform](https://www.culturalbrain.net/platform): product overview and capabilities.
- [Research Center](https://www.culturalbrain.net/research-center): research and audience evidence.
- [CEREBRO](https://www.culturalbrain.net/cerebro): evidence and strategic hypotheses.
- [Sofía](https://www.culturalbrain.net/sofia): assistant experience.
- [Pulse](https://www.culturalbrain.net/pulse): cultural signals.
- [Learning Loop](https://www.culturalbrain.net/learning-loop): hypotheses, results and learning.
- [How it works](https://www.culturalbrain.net/how-it-works): workflow.
- [Agencies](https://www.culturalbrain.net/solutions/agencies): agency use cases.
- [Brands](https://www.culturalbrain.net/solutions/brands): brand use cases.
- [Resources](https://www.culturalbrain.net/resources): research and product resources.
- [Plans and access](https://www.culturalbrain.net/pricing): access and guided demo information.

## Related public sources
- [Hispaño](https://www.hispan.io/): organization and cultural research.
- [Methodology](https://www.hispan.io/methodology): research methodology.

Examples and demos are not independent evidence of customer outcomes. Consult the linked public pages for scope and limitations.
